children: OTTAWA--Unemployment in Canada held steady in August despite an unexpected drop in employment.

Statistics Canada reported Friday that Canada's economy lost a net 41,700 jobs last month. Market expectations were for employment to increase by about 15,000, after the country added 75,100 jobs the month before.
The unemployment rate held at 6.4%, in line with expectations and following declines the previous month totalling half a percentage point.
Canada's total labor force contracted by 36,800 last month, taking back some of the 60,500 gain in July.
When calculated using U.S. Labor Department methodology, Canada's unemployment rate last month was unchanged for a third straight month at 5.3%.

Canada Unemployment Rate Holds at 6.4% in August
OTTAWA--Unemployment in Canada held steady in August despite an unexpected drop in employment.

Statistics Canada reported Friday that Canada's economy lost a net 41,700 jobs last month. Market expectations were for employment to increase by about 15,000, after the country added 75,100 jobs the month before.
The unemployment rate held at 6.4%, in line with expectations and following declines the previous month totalling half a percentage point.
Canada's total labor force contracted by 36,800 last month, taking back some of the 60,500 gain in July.
When calculated using U.S. Labor Department methodology, Canada's unemployment rate last month was unchanged for a third straight month at 5.3%.
